Difficulty per question: easy 38, average 6, difficult 12, untagged 2.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 68 (heading 'Lesson 16' — no title printed), 69-72; A pdf 167 (heading 'Lesson 16 : THE CHANGING FAMILIES') 168-170.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following :' q26 (10 rows); s5 one mark q28-37 vsa (heading printed as '27. Answer the following questions: (one mark questions) (easy)'); s6 two marks q037b-q46 sa; s7 three marks q046b-q51 sa; s8 four marks q52-57 la.

NUMBERING (analysis: reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-16_numbering_analysis.md): ruled shapes only — stray label on a heading (gap), repeated labels with letter suffixes, two offset bands on the default lane (empty + 'shifted numbering — see key N'), one question with no key, a boundary flag on q051.

KEY FORM: fill keys = completed sentences (verbatim); keys 37-56 restate/paraphrase the question on the number line (restated()); q52 bullets with 'o' sub-bullets — 'Nuclear Family:' / 'Joint Family:' are headings, the four merit/demerit lines are steps. Answer-side section headings are mislabelled ('One Mark Questions' above keys 47-51) — never used (v2 §2).
q050 untagged; q57 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
